question:
A wholesale distributor supplies flour and rice. Each kg flour takes 2 hours of labor, 1 hour for rice. 100 hours labor are available daily. At least 10 kg of each must be supplied. Each flour earns ₹30 profit; rice ₹20. What distribution maximizes profit?

(a) Write the LPP.

(b) Sketch and find feasible region corners.

(c) Calculate the values giving the maximum profit.

options.A:
(a) Max $Z=30x+20y$ with $2x+y\leq100$, $x\geq10$, $y\geq10$
(b) Corners: $(10,10)$, $(45,10)$, $(10,80)$
(c) Supply 45 kg flour and 10 kg rice; maximum profit ₹1550.
options.B:
(a) Max $Z=30x+20y$ with $2x+y\leq100$, $x\geq10$, $y\geq10$
(b) Corners: $(10,10)$, $(45,10)$, $(10,80)$
(c) Supply 10 kg flour and 10 kg rice; maximum profit ₹500.
options.C:
(a) Max $Z=30x+20y$ with $2x+y\leq100$, $x\geq10$, $y\geq10$
(b) Corners: $(10,10)$, $(45,10)$, $(10,80)$
(c) Supply 10 kg flour and 80 kg rice; maximum profit ₹1900.
options.D:
(a) Max $Z=30x+20y$ with $2x+y\leq100$, $x\geq10$, $y\geq10$
(b) Corners: $(10,10)$, $(50,0)$, $(10,80)$
(c) Supply 50 kg flour and 0 kg rice; maximum profit ₹1500.
